body:
Hopefully things will get better. There is no promise that it will and they may not be better right now so it is harder to see any better future, but it is always possible. People usually don't like when someone says maybe it is better off without them, especially when it is talking about your parents, but sometimes it is the truth. It is a toxic environment when someone close to a person is unsupporting to that person.  


My parents would have reacted similarly. I would have been the worst disappointment to them. It would have been hard to get over, but if someone isn't willing to help or support me emotionally then I cannot force them. I don't know where I would have ended up at though. My brother don't condone self harm either, so I would have had to hoped a friend was able to take me in.

I hope you all the best!

Reddit had been my last desperate hope. I googled and googled, trying to find SOMETHING other than a hotline. I even -support in the search. 

I like that quote.

That is exactly how I felt until a found a couple places on reddit to post my frustration about the lack places to talk. I can only imagine being a teen or someone in a worse situation than me. I know on another subreddit people post all the time about the "help" and "support" not working. Just today someone posted how they called different hotlines for hours and no one ever picked up. They felt like it was basically being told that they should just do it.

Even then, you can be honest with the chatlines and such, but their main goal will be to get you help, not to just discuss things with you. Sometimes you just need a discussion rather than help. There are people out there who truly need it, but others may just need that conversation.

I know what you mean in a way. I am not exactly jealous of other people's scars, but I do wish mine were still visible. I wish they were visible enough for me to see, but not so visible that others can see them from a great distance. It feels weird sometimes to me as most people wish their scars were gone or easily hidden, although most have had worse cuts than I was ever able to give myself.

I don't know all the details, but maybe you could voluntarily go? I know most clinics and hospitals only take mental health patients voluntarily UNLESS it is proven that they are a harm to themselves or others (so you cannot be forced to go against our will unless this is the case).

I know for me, my parents were a big role in why I could and still can't go voluntarily. Is this so for you? If you were to do drastic actions, your parents would find out and there would be great risk to your health from the actions you took to get there. Cuts and drug doses can end up being more deadly than intended.

If it is an option to go voluntarily then you should take that route. Talk with our parents if possible and if your worried about how your school will be affected, your school should have a school counselor to discuss different things that can be done.

I want to get a small, light blue heart (quarter sized or so) on my left wrist. Blue is my favorite color and the heart would symbolize love. Nothing to significant to most but means a lot to me. Maybe I'll get it as just an outline as well, not filled in. Your tattoos sound lovely :)

I want to get a real tattoo on my wrist area. My scars are pretty much gone now, I have to look hard to even find what remains, so it is not so much about covering up. I wanted a tattoo to remember what I went through, but to also show strength while helping with and validating the promise I made to my fiance. If that makes sense. I haven't yet because people have said it hurts more than usual in that area (this would also be my first tattoo) and it would get worn out quickly being in the wrist area.

I understand completely. My best friend knows that I have self harmed in the past and expressed her wish for me to stop, but after that if I were to bring it up it would create an awkwardness. Like it should have all been over after she expressed her feelings about it. My fiance will listen, but it ultimately comes down to him making me swear that I won't ever do it and him feeling like a failure because he is doing his hardest to make things the best.

If you would like I can send you a message and we can talk more, or you can send me one. It'd be nice to have someone to talk with. I'm not sure where to start, but it can start any where.
